title: Pure Engine Token
summary: The Engine Token (Motor) archetype is Bandit Keith and Yako Tenma's DARK Machine series from Yu-Gi-Oh! R, consisting of Motor Kaiser, Motor Frenzy, Motor Shell, Fiendish Engine Ω, and Two-for-One Repair Job. Every monster generates Level 1 EARTH Machine 'Engine Tokens' (200 ATK / 200 DEF) when destroying cards or hitting the GY, fueling Tribute Summons, Two-for-One Repair Job revivals, and Machine Link climbing.

allow.Scrap Recycler: Level 3 EARTH Machine starter that sends Motor Shell or Fiendish Engine Ω from the Deck to the GY (setting up Two-for-One Repair Job) and recycles Level 4 EARTH Machines.
allow.Therion \"King\" Regulus: Equips Motor Shell or Scrap Recycler from the GY to Special Summon itself and provide omni-negation (and if Motor Shell leaves the field while equipped, it generates an Engine Token!).
allow.Clockwork Night: Continuous Spell searched by Clockwork Knight that turns all monsters on the field into Machines, boosts your Machines by 500 ATK, and banishes from GY to search Scrap Recycler or Therion "King" Regulus.
allow.Foolish Burial: Sends Motor Shell or Fiendish Engine Ω to the GY to enable Two-for-One Repair Job (1 copy, Limited in TCG).
allow.Clockwork Knight: Link-1 EARTH Machine that can be summoned using a Level 1 EARTH Machine Engine Token, searches Clockwork Night, and tributes a Machine to revive an EARTH Machine.
allow.Link Spider: Link-1 EARTH Cyberse summoned using an Engine Token to convert tokens into Effect Monsters for Link climbing.
allow.Ancient Gear Ballista: Link-2 EARTH Machine made using two EARTH Machine Engine Tokens that pops a Spell/Trap to drop an opposing monster to 0 ATK/DEF.
allow.Platinum Gadget: Link-2 Machine made with Motor Shell + Engine Token that Special Summons a Level 4 or lower Machine from the hand.

main: Level 5 DARK Machine that reveals itself in hand to immediately Normal Summon 1 DARK Machine (using an Engine Token as Tribute!), and targets 1 monster you control (Motor Shell!) to destroy it and Special Summon 1 Engine Token.

Core Level 4 DARK Machine that automatically Special Summons 1 'Engine Token' (Machine/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 200/DEF 200) whenever it is sent from the field to the GY (including as Link or Tribute Material!).

Level 6 DARK Machine that gains ATK equal to half the highest original DEF of a Machine used for its Tribute Summon, protects your monsters from battle Position changes, and summons 2 Engine Tokens when sent to the GY after being Tribute Summoned.
Signature Level 8 DARK Machine boss with 2800 ATK that Special Summons 1 Engine Token in Attack Position during every End Phase and boosts its own ATK by 1000 (to 3800 ATK).
Normal Summon starter that sends Motor Shell, Motor Kaiser, or Fiendish Engine Ω directly from the Deck to the GY.
Special Summons itself by equipping Motor Shell from your GY; when Regulus sends the equipped Motor Shell to the GY to negate an opponent's card, Motor Shell triggers to summon an Engine Token!

Archetypal Spell that banishes 1 DARK Machine from your GY to Special Summon 1 monster from your hand, Deck, or GY that specifically lists 'Engine Token' in its text (Fiendish Engine Ω, Motor Kaiser, Motor Frenzy, or Motor Shell!), and banishes from GY when your DARK Machine is destroyed to summon an Engine Token.
Continuous Spell searched by Clockwork Knight that boosts all your Machines/Engine Tokens by 500 ATK, weakens opponent's monsters by 500 ATK, and banishes from GY to search Regulus.
Dumps Motor Shell or Fiendish Engine Ω to turn on Two-for-One Repair Job immediately.
extra: Link-1 EARTH Machine summoned directly using a single Level 1 EARTH Machine 'Engine Token'! Sends a Continuous Spell to search Clockwork Night and tributes a Machine (Motor Shell!) to revive Scrap Recycler.
Link-1 summoned using an Engine Token to convert tokens into Effect Monsters.
Link-2 EARTH Machine summoned using two EARTH Machine Engine Tokens to search an EARTH Machine and reduce an opposing monster's stats to 0.
Link-2 Machine that summons Motor Shell or Scrap Recycler from the hand.
